jobs.description: We are looking for an Electrical Commissioning Specialist at Academic Work Finland Oy in Helsinki, Vantaa, Kerava, and surrounding areas. Planning, monitoring, verifying results for L4-level system and functional tests.
Supporting the planning and execution of the L5 Integrated System Test (IST) phase and verifying inter-system functionality.
